notes.title: Pixelnest announces CTHULOOT!

Hello pirates slashers,

notes.title: Steredenn: Steam hull maintenance
notes.notes:
Hello!

We did some Steredenn maintenance today. We changed the depots / the app configuration on Steam.

Before, we had the old game available on the regular app. The DLC files would replace the old game.
This allowed a cool feature: we could switch between the old and new game when the DLC was released.

However, as we updated the engine, the file structure changed and we had some duplicated librairies causing crash on Linux / Steamdeck, or macOS installation write errors.

We took the decision to remove the old build. Now, the app has the latest version of the game and the DLC is... empty!

We hope this will solve Steamdeck & macOS issues and not cause any new ones.

Please send us a message if it's not the case.

Also: expect some news from the team this year!

Cheers!
Damien & the Steredenn's team

notes.title: Steredenn 2.4.0: The Sixth Extinction
notes.notes:
Guess we're all wrong sometime?

We thought the last big patch would be the last, but alas, some bugs crippled the game performances during high-end loops. 

We fixed most of the bugs — well, we hope —, and since we were at it, we added some nice little things as well. Better late than never.

However, I should mention that, to correct some of these bugs, we also had to re-balance the loops and some items.

This shall be the last. Thanks again!
Bye, wanderers.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Add screenshake setting.
[*] The Red Baron starts the game with its own background (except if you let the full intro plays).
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes/technical stuffs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improve performances in loops.
[*] Improve performances of suicide bullets.
[*] Rework the Stasisgun , Stasisbot, and Rocket Circus animation (the weird blue gel). This should fix most of the bugs that you encountered while using these weapons. And bonus: it's prettier.
[*] Fix a crash when a Lightsaber hit an Heavy Shielder.
[*] Fix stacking blockers on Mothership.
[*] Fix a bug with Bots' ghosts being generated almost endlessly in specific conditions.
[*] Fix Stars-less backgrounds.
[*] Fix bugs with the Bulletstorm event.
[/list]
[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improve Hypergun. It deals way more damage against normal enemies. It's a bit weaker against bosses.
[*] Improve Ultrabeam. Faster, larger, more predictable.
[*] Ancient Power doesn't trigger suicide bullets in loops.
[*] Tweak Battleship boss' first pattern.
[*] Reduce number of blockers in loop 3+.
[*] Reset the SUPERCHABAL and Asteroworm counters at the beginning of a loop.
[*] Spawn more events in loops.
[*] Improve the generation of suicide bullets.
[*] Improve the generation of blockers in loops.
[*] Rework enemies' bullets speed in loops.
[/list]

— Steredenn’s team.

notes.title: Steredenn: Binary Stars
notes.notes:
[b]Steredenn: Binary Stars[/b] is finally available on Steam!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8738527/21fd88faf9837a1f6f21a4766077ff782bfec72c.png[/img]

It's bundled as a free DLC, automatically included with your [b]Steredenn[/b] purchase. Restart Steam, and you should see a new update available. You get the [b]2.0.0[/b], [b]2.1.0[/b] and [b]2.1.1[/b] updates in one package.

[b]The leaderboards are also new[/b]. You can still check the old ones, but [b]Steredenn: Binary Stars[/b] is a fresh start for everyone.

To recap quickly what [b]Steredenn: Binary Stars[/b] is:
[list]
[*] Local 2-players co-op mode;
[*] 5 new playable ships;
[*] Boss Rush mode;
[*] Tons of new content (music, bosses, upgrades, weapons, waves).
[/list]
Below, you will find the 3 changelogs, if you want to read more about the changes.

You can switch between [b]Steredenn: Classic[/b] and [b]Steredenn: Binary Stars[/b] at will, just by clicking the checkbox in the DLC list.

Obviously, there isn't many reasons to play [b]Steredenn: Classic[/b] instead of [b]Steredenn: Binary Stars[/b], but if you are nostalgic, it's still possible. ;)
[list]
[*] [url=http://steredenn.pixelnest.io/]Check the official Steredenn: Binary Stars website.[/url]
[*] [url=https://zandernoriega.bandcamp.com/album/steredenn-binary-stars-original-game-soundtrack]Listen to the new soundtrack.[/url]
[*] [url=http://steredenn.pixelnest.io/faq/]Read the FAQ about our thought-process and decisions behind the update.[/url]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8738527/453202739d2a5369d5e5b1d4836651cd7f0c7c0a.png[/img]

[h1]Steredenn 2.0.0: Binary Stars[/h1]

After a year of work, we are excited to release [b]Steredenn: Binary Stars[/b], the hugely improved and massively expanded version of Steredenn.

This changelog, as you might expect, is a big one. This update changes so many things that we thought it deserved the big number increase.

- [b]Your savegame will be deleted.[/b] It's a new start. We revamped the progression system, and we think it will be better for everyone to experience it. Don't worry, for an experienced player, this won't take long (you just lose the Arena and unlocked weapons, after all).
- The leaderboards will be erased too. With the new scoring system and mechanics, it doesn't make sense to keep the current ones.

What's in this 2.0.0? The main highlights are:

- 5 playable ships with a new [i]special ability[/i] mechanic.
- Local 2-players co-op mode.
- And many more new and upgraded things. Read on for a detailed list.

It's a culmination of a ton of work from our part. This makes Steredenn an even better game: the experience has been enriched and diversified in many ways. I don't think we can really improve the game anymore (except for bugs — fixing bugs is a never-ending task like this game). Not in its current form anyways. ;)

Enough chit-chat, let's dive in!

[i]A fair warning: this changelog is very exhaustive and contains [b]SPOILERS[/b]. If you want a pure experience without knowing anything, don't read it. You have been warned.[/i] 😉

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] 5 playable ships.
[*] Local 2-players co-op mode with special leaderboard.
[*] Boss rush mode. Face a pre-selected roaster of bosses, and beat them! You can try as many times as you want, and your score will go ina special leaderboard. This is a weekly challenge.
[*] Secret bosses. If you do a certain thing (Zhu Li, do the thing!), you will earn the privilege to fight against one of the secret bosses.
[*] 3 new music tracks: Binary Stars, Supermassive, Star Devourers. [url=https://zandernoriega.bandcamp.com/album/steredenn-binary-stars-original-game-soundtrack]Listen on Bandcamp[/url].
[*] Cargos can drop Medkits and Ultramedkits. This is rare, but it can save you from an ineluctable death.
[/list]
[i]Ships[/i]
[list]
[*] New ship: the "Tempest". This is actually the current existing ship — same speed, same health, same damages. Its special ability is to use a melee weapon as a third weapon. Taking a melee weapons has a [b]real value[/b] now, without any handicap. Yes: you can have the cake and eat it!
[*] New ship: the "Fortress". It's slow, it does less damages, but can absorb many more hits. Its special ability is a rain of homing rockets. There's no subtlety here: just rush into the battlefield. Everything is gonna be fine, trust us.
[*] New ship: the "Fury". You got less health, but more damages. And this ship is fast! Its special ability is a teleport. Press the button, choose your target, and bam! You're there. If you quickly press the button, it will teleport a few light-years before you instantly. Because it's Steredenn, the teleportation is, obviously, [b]explosive[/b]. If you teleport near an enemy ship, there's a good chance that you will wreck it.
[*] New ship: the "Specialist". The master of Bots. This ship is radically different from the previous ones. You can only use Bots. If you orbitate near them, they will become invincible, [b]so use them as a wall![/b] Its special ability is a Boosterbot and you can only have one at a time. This Bot changes the behavior of the other Bots under its aura. For example, a Gunbot will fire a huge number of bullets in a larger cone, but will deplete faster. A Bot under the influence of the Boosterbot is not necessarily better, but its new behavior can be used to handle different situations. This is key to the gameplay of the Specialist. Try everybot, with or without the booster, and you will understand.
[*] New ship: the "Red Baron". Like the Specialist, this ship is completely different. This time, you start the game with 4 abilities and that's all. No cargo, nothing else. The first ability is a spread gun to destroy light targets. The second ability is a huge laser. Yes, you read it right. A freaking huge laser!! This is your main weapon against medium targets. Finally, your last weapon is a grenade. You can charge it to launch it far away. The more you charge, the more damages it will deal. The last ability is not a weapon, but a Speed Boost. Move at an unparalled velocity and dodge everything, or re-deploy yourself quickly in better spots and fire at will!
[/list]
[i]Bosses[/i]
[list]
[*] 2 new bosses.
[*] New boss: "Cruiser MK-II".
[*] New boss: "Carrier MK-II".
[*] 6 new secret bosses.
[*] New secret boss: "Verdukul".
[*] New secret boss: "An Old Friend".
[*] New secret boss: "Garbage Collector".
[*] New secret boss: "Alien Threat".
[*] New secret boss: "SUPERCHABAL".
[*] New secret boss: "The Red Baron".
[/list]
[i]Weapons[/i]
[list]
[*] The "Bullet" category has now 11 weapons, 12 with the default.
[*] The "Energy" category has now 11 weapons, 12 with the default.
[*] The "Heavy" category has now 11 weapons, 12 with the default.
[*] The "Bot" category has now 10 weapons, 11 with the default, and 12 with the Boosterbot.
[*] New "Bullet" weapon: "Helixer".
[*] New "Bullet" weapon: "Hypershotgun". We had a shotgun. But no Hypershotgun. What a shame. This is fixed.
[*] New "Bullet" weapon: "Sniper". Check the cursor: if you target a special area of an enemy, you can demultiply the damages you'll give.
[*] New "Energy" weapon: "Fusion Blaster" (Fury's default weapon).
[*] New "Energy" weapon: "Fusion Hyperblaster".
[*] New "Energy" weapon: "Lightgun". A pulse of light rays.
[*] New "Energy" weapon: "Ultrabeam". Take the Ultralaser, apply the reverse effect and bam: the Ultrabeam. Focus on an enemy, don't release your fire and watch it get bigger overtime.
[*] New "Energy" weapon: "GLORYHAMMER". Faster than a laser bullet. 😎
[*] New "Heavy" weapon: "Fire Blaster" (Fortress' default weapon).
[*] New "Heavy" weapon: "Fire Hyperblaster". You might have understood now that we love the word Hyper?
[*] New "Heavy" weapon: "Frag Missiles". If your big girl/boy doesn't reach its target, it will destructure itself into many homing missiles.
[*] New "Heavy" weapon: "Lag Cannon". 😇
[*] New "Bot" weapon: "Blasterbot" (Specialist's default weapon). Combine the three other default weapons for a devastating effect.
[*] New "Bot" weapon: "Fusionbot".
[*] New "Bot" weapon: "Demuxbot".
[*] New "Bot" weapon: "Ninjabot". Trained in the dark art of stealth, your Ninjabots can conceal themselves into the Darkness of Space.
[*] New "Bot" weapon: "Drillerbot". With the Specialist, you can hold them and create a huge stack of mini-drills.
[*] New "Bot" weapon: "Laserbot".
[*] New "Melee" weapon: "Razorblade" (Tempest's default special ability). Tiny but handy.
[/list]
[i]Events[/i]
[list]
[*] 4 new events.
[*] New event: "Bumpers". A bumpy ride awaits you.
[*] New event: "Bulletmines". Okay, mines were great. A bulletmine? More laughter!
[*] New event: "Bulletstorm". At this point, a bulletstorm shouldn't surprise you, right?
[*] New event: "Quantum Asteroid Field". We thought the Asteroid Fields were too easy and we should add a variant that can teleport. Because we can. 😎
[/list]
[i]Upgrades[/i]
[list]
[*] Upgrades have a title and a description. This way, you can better understand the actual effect of an upgrade.
[*] 5 new upgrades.
[*] New upgrade: "Chain Reaction". When an enemy ship is destroyed, it creates a small shockwave. Which can trigger another shockwave.
[*] New upgrade: "Guardian Angel". Prevent death once per level. Basically, it gives you another HP when you should have died the first time it happens.
[*] New upgrade: "Heavy Armor". When you are hit by a bullet that does 3 (or more) damages, it reduces the amount you take by one.
[*] New upgrade: "Ancient Power". Create an electric damage aura around you in a small radius.

It's bundled as a free DLC, automatically included with your [b]Steredenn[/b] purchase. Restart Steam, and you should see a new update available. You get the [b]2.0.0[/b], [b]2.1.0[/b] and [b]2.1.1[/b] updates in one package.

[b]The leaderboards are also new[/b]. You can still check the old ones, but [b]Steredenn: Binary Stars[/b] is a fresh start for everyone.

To recap quickly what [b]Steredenn: Binary Stars[/b] is:
[list]
[*] Local 2-players co-op mode;
[*] 5 new playable ships;
[*] Boss Rush mode;
[*] Tons of new content (music, bosses, upgrades, weapons, waves).
[/list]
Below, you will find the 3 changelogs, if you want to read more about the changes.

You can switch between [b]Steredenn: Classic[/b] and [b]Steredenn: Binary Stars[/b] at will, just by clicking the checkbox in the DLC list.

Obviously, there isn't many reasons to play [b]Steredenn: Classic[/b] instead of [b]Steredenn: Binary Stars[/b], but if you are nostalgic, it's still possible. ;)

[*] [url=http://steredenn.pixelnest.io/]Check the official Steredenn: Binary Stars website.[/url]

[h1]Steredenn 2.0.0: Binary Stars[/h1]

After a year of work, we are excited to release [b]Steredenn: Binary Stars[/b], the hugely improved and massively expanded version of Steredenn.

This changelog, as you might expect, is a big one. This update changes so many things that we thought it deserved the big number increase.

- [b]Your savegame will be deleted.[/b] It's a new start. We revamped the progression system, and we think it will be better for everyone to experience it. Don't worry, for an experienced player, this won't take long (you just lose the Arena and unlocked weapons, after all).
- The leaderboards will be erased too. With the new scoring system and mechanics, it doesn't make sense to keep the current ones.

What's in this 2.0.0? The main highlights are:

- 5 playable ships with a new [i]special ability[/i] mechanic.
- Local 2-players co-op mode.
- And many more new and upgraded things. Read on for a detailed list.

It's a culmination of a ton of work from our part. This makes Steredenn an even better game: the experience has been enriched and diversified in many ways. I don't think we can really improve the game anymore (except for bugs — fixing bugs is a never-ending task like this game). Not in its current form anyways. ;)

Enough chit-chat, let's dive in!

[i]A fair warning: this changelog is very exhaustive and contains [b]SPOILERS[/b]. If you want a pure experience without knowing anything, don't read it. You have been warned.[/i] 😉

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] 5 playable ships.
[*] Local 2-players co-op mode with special leaderboard.
[*] Boss rush mode. Face a pre-selected roaster of bosses, and beat them! You can try as many times as you want, and your score will go ina special leaderboard. This is a weekly challenge.
[*] Secret bosses. If you do a certain thing (Zhu Li, do the thing!), you will earn the privilege to fight against one of the secret bosses.
[*] 3 new music tracks: Binary Stars, Supermassive, Star Devourers. [url=https://zandernoriega.bandcamp.com/album/steredenn-binary-stars-original-game-soundtrack]Listen on Bandcamp[/url].
[*] Cargos can drop Medkits and Ultramedkits. This is rare, but it can save you from an ineluctable death.
[/list]
[i]Ships[/i]
[list]
[*] New ship: the "Tempest". This is actually the current existing ship — same speed, same health, same damages. Its special ability is to use a melee weapon as a third weapon. Taking a melee weapons has a [b]real value[/b] now, without any handicap. Yes: you can have the cake and eat it!
[*] New ship: the "Fortress". It's slow, it does less damages, but can absorb many more hits. Its special ability is a rain of homing rockets. There's no subtlety here: just rush into the battlefield. Everything is gonna be fine, trust us.
[*] New ship: the "Fury". You got less health, but more damages. And this ship is fast! Its special ability is a teleport. Press the button, choose your target, and bam! You're there. If you quickly press the button, it will teleport a few light-years before you instantly. Because it's Steredenn, the teleportation is, obviously, [b]explosive[/b]. If you teleport near an enemy ship, there's a good chance that you will wreck it.
[*] New ship: the "Specialist". The master of Bots. This ship is radically different from the previous ones. You can only use Bots. If you orbitate near them, they will become invincible, [b]so use them as a wall![/b] Its special ability is a Boosterbot and you can only have one at a time. This Bot changes the behavior of the other Bots under its aura. For example, a Gunbot will fire a huge number of bullets in a larger cone, but will deplete faster. A Bot under the influence of the Boosterbot is not necessarily better, but its new behavior can be used to handle different situations. This is key to the gameplay of the Specialist. Try everybot, with or without the booster, and you will understand.
[*] New ship: the "Red Baron". Like the Specialist, this ship is completely different. This time, you start the game with 4 abilities and that's all. No cargo, nothing else. The first ability is a spread gun to destroy light targets. The second ability is a huge laser. Yes, you read it right. A freaking huge laser!! This is your main weapon against medium targets. Finally, your last weapon is a grenade. You can charge it to launch it far away. The more you charge, the more damages it will deal. The last ability is not a weapon, but a Speed Boost. Move at an unparalled velocity and dodge everything, or re-deploy yourself quickly in better spots and fire at will!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8738527/453202739d2a5369d5e5b1d4836651cd7f0c7c0a.png[/img]

[h1]Steredenn 2.1.0: Switching Guns[/h1]

A new patch with many critical fixes and improvements for Binary Stars.

What's new?

To sum up quickly: we have increased the performances, slashed many bugs, improved the Specialist, reworked small lasers, destroyed tons of crashes, and added new contents.

It never ends! Like the universe… ha ha… ha? 🙄

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Add 3 environments.
[*] Rocks, mines, bulletmines, bumpers and other small explodable elements have a small movement.
[*] Use bumpers on gamepads.
[*] Improve first level's background. It's huuuge. The whole solar system. Waow. 😱😱😱
[*] Improve loop first level's background.
[*] Improve vibrations on gamepads (if supported). Way way better!
[*] Improve texts.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes/technical stuffs[/b]
[list]
[*] Increase performances for bullets and Asteroid Fields.
[*] Optimize Stasisbot and Stasisgun.
[*] Use correct background for special bosses in Arena.
[*] Handle language change in the settings in a smoother way.
[*] Rework Arena starting animation.
[*] Add Pro Controller support on PC.
[*] Fix Tempest taking a normal weapon in its melee slot (which was not a viable strategy since the weapon was not useable, sorry).
[*] Fix spamming bugs with the Tempest special ability.
[*] Fix Garbage Collector cross pattern.
[*] Fix some errors in texts.
[*] Fix some bugs in Arena's game over.
[*] Fix some starting weapons not considered unlocked by default.
[*] Fix bug with two identical controllers considered the same in co-op.
[*] Fix artefacts being dropped after the destruction of a miniboss in the Arena.
[*] Fix the Rocket Circus' targeting during the Asteroworm fight.
[*] Fix a rare date bug in Daily Run.
[*] Fix Red Baron boss' trail not cleaned correctly during hypespaces.
[*] Fix trails when the SUPERCHABAL is destroyed.
[*] Fix mini-Garbage Collector trails.
[*] Fix audio bugs.
[*] Fix pesky misalignment issues for special ability UI.
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Tweak Specialist for a better game experience. Changes below.
[*] Bots under the Specialist Aura have a bigger shield radius.
[*] Bots under the Specialist Aura are pushed back each time they get hit. You have to move to stay behind them. This is a big change, but it's a good one, don't worry. ;)
[*] Specialist can stop freefalling Bots by coming near them.
[*] Bots can target new enemies more quickly.
[*] Ghost Bots (from Next-Gen Special) ignore the Specialist aura.
[*] Remove Specialist passive bonus damage.
[*] Reduce Fury special ability damage bonus.
[*] Reduce Ninjabot damage.
[*] Reduce Minirockets damage and increase cooldown.
[*] Reduce Quick Reload bonus a bit.
[*] Reduce Laserbot damage.
[*] Balance Flamebot.
[*] Increase Ancient Power damage.
[*] Modify Cruiser MK2 patterns conditions.
[*] Modify Gunbot boost mode.
[*] Melee weapons don't trigger suicide bullets in loops.
[*] Change damage type of Red Baron's spread weapon.
[*] Improve heal speed of a health capsule.
[*] Shieldbots last longer but can only be spawned twice with a bigger cooldown.
[*] Shieldbots can stop laser.
[*] Shieldbots don't destroy ally bots created near them.
[*] Shieldbots are less vulnerable to collisions.
[*] Shieldbots blink more when they are almost discharged.
[*] Shieldbots last longer under the Specialist aura.
[*] Rework Reflector to be more intuitive and easier to use.
[*] Reflector shows an animation when fully charged.
[*] Shield shows an animation when fully charged.
[*] Shield stops small lasers.
[*] Change probabilities on SUPERCHABAL and Asteroworm.
[*] Increase cooldown of the Baygun.
[*] Reduce number of bullets reflected by the Heavy Shielder.
[*] Rename "Reconfigured Slot Design" to "Improved Reconfiguration System".
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8738527/453202739d2a5369d5e5b1d4836651cd7f0c7c0a.png[/img]

[h1]Steredenn 2.1.1: Orbit Correction[/h1]

We continue with a bunch of small improvements and fixes, especially for Steam, Xbox One, and PS4 releases.

The main improvement is on the UI, where we finally found a way to improve retina screens support (offering us the chance to remove many hacks that were required with previous Unity versions). This is cleaner and better, yay. 🙋‍♀️🙋‍♂️

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Cinema mode is now permanent and you have to disable it manually in the settings.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes/technical stuffs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix incorrect music (or no music) after a restart with the Specialist.
[*] Fix tons of hacks in the UI, allowing us to handle resolution changes and retina screens correctly all the time.
[*] Fix white noise sound staying after being defeated by the Nemesis.
[*] Fix (again) bots and Autocannon targeting an out-of-screen enemy.
[*] Fix a sound bug at the end of the Arena.
[*] Fix a bug with Mines and generators.
[*] Fix a bug with Shotgun and EMP mines.
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Increase Helixer's side cannons damages.
[*] Decrease Helixer's main cannon damage. Overall, the Helixer deals more damage.
[*] Increase cooldown of Stasisbot.
[*] Increase cooldown of Frag Missile.
[*] Reduce movement speed of Frag Missile.
[*] Change combo bonus of "SUPERMASSIVE GLORIOUS SURVIVOR" artefact.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8738527/453202739d2a5369d5e5b1d4836651cd7f0c7c0a.png[/img]

As always, thanks for your support and do not hesitate to send feedbacks on the forums. ;)

Special thanks to Simon Coroller, Etienne Marque, Zander Noriega, Anaïs Mayance, Claire Thouault, Krokmou, Kevin Scatton and Plug-in-Digital - as well as our fantastic players! 👏

Out.

Damien Mayance & Matthieu Oger.

notes.title: Steredenn 1.2.0: Days of Conquest
notes.notes:
Hi,

Today is the [b]second anniversary of Pixelnest[/b]. We cooked a small surprise for the occasion. ;)

We all love Daily Runs. They bring a breath of fresh air to the game every day. We thought we could improve them quite a bit by adding new options, like upgrades or loops right from the beginning. 

The new musics are also there. [url=https://zandernoriega.bandcamp.com/track/science-magic]Science Magic[/url] and [url=https://zandernoriega.bandcamp.com/track/tensor-forces]Tensor Forces[/url] join the roster. Thanks to [url=https://zandernoriega.bandcamp.com/album/steredenn-original-soundtrack]Zander Noriega[/url], as usual. ;)

Users on Linux might have to upgrade their OpenGL installation. It's beyond our control, unfortunately.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] New musics: [b]Science Magic[/b] and [b]Tensor Forces[/b].
[*] Improved "Daily Run" with upgrades, loops, cargos and weapons.
[*] Add new controllers.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes/technical stuffs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix the mines against the Destroyer MK-II.
[*] Fix the raygun sound when swapping.
[*] Fix some labels.
[*] Increase the size of the raygun.
[/list]
[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increase the damages of the Boomerang.
[*] Increase the damages of the Rockets.
[*] Increase the damages of the Megagun.
[*] Reduce the max time of a wave the further you loop the game.
[/list]
As always, thanks for your support and do not hesitate to send feedbacks on the Steam forums. ;)

Out.

— Steredenn’s team.


[i]UPDATE: We rollbacked the [b]Linux[/b] version to [b]1.1.1[/b]. The issue with OpenGL was bigger than we expected. Because we are dependent on our engine's updates, we need a bit more time to fix the situation. Sorry for the inconvenience.[/i] :/

notes.title: Steredenn 0.25.0: Dashboard Operational
notes.notes:
Hello,

Small update today. We took some time to work on the translations of the game and [b]we added keyboard re-mapping[/b], as well as an improved UI for input controls.

[img]http://pixelnest.io/work/steredenn/medias/teleport.png[/img]

This release is shaping the game for the official release. And we might have fixed the few remaining nasty bugs. :)

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Keyboard re-mapping. Yep. Open "Settings", then "Mappings" and here you go.
[*] Improve the controls display in the UI: the icons represent your current input method. With support for PS4 controllers.
[*] New ending.
[*] Improve the tutorial with texts skipping and two new explanations.
[*] Add the "Credits" panel.
[*] Slightly improved the Arena UI.
[*] New teleport effect for enemy ships. Not really visible in the current version. ;)
[*] The "Shield" upgrade has been improved visually.
[*] Continue the work on the game translation (many additional languages will be available on release day).
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes/technical stuffs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Small optimizations.
[*] We think that we have (once again) found the origin of the freezes between waves. We hope that this time, it will be the last time. Tell us!
[*] Correct a bug with the sliders in the Settings.
[*] The music is correctly stopped when you quit a game or the Arena.
[*] The loops won't use the same wave twice.
[*] For people with input lags problem, launch the game with the special flag "-noxinput" and tell us if it improves the game.
[/list]
[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Saw is available earlier.
[*] The Jaw deals more damages.
[*] The Reflector lasts 0.1s more.
[*] The Reflector starts in the player's direction.
[*] Tweaked the upgrades drop chances.
[*] Slightly reworded the events probabilities.
[*] The Laser Rain gives +100% bonus score instead of 50%.
[*] The "Shield" upgrade works with "Reflect damages when hit" and is not broken when hit by a junk piece.
[*] You need to see the bosses a bit less to unlock them in the Arena. For the Mothership, only two encounters will be necessary, for example.
[/list]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347160/discussions/0/523897277923137254/]Give us your feedbacks on the forums![/url]

Good game.

Out.

— Steredenn’s team.

notes.title: Steredenn: release on October, 1st
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Big new today: [b]Steredenn is going to be officially released on October 1st[/b]!

It will be out of Early Access at the price of [b]$12.99[/b] with a [b]-15%[/b] sale during the first week to celebrate. [b]As a quick reminder, the game will remain at $8.99 until October 1st[/b]. Don't hesitate to get it now or offer it to your friends while it's still low. ;)

We have finally reached the goals we wanted to achieve with the game. We are proud of what we have done during the Early Access and by the support you gave us. We even did many things we didn’t plan at all, like original new weapons, upgrades and other stuffs, thanks to you.

We are a very small team (only 2 people full-time). It’s time to consider that the game is complete. We don’t want to fall into the trap of a never-ending development. Our aim with Steredenn was to do an Early Access the right way: gather feedbacks, include original ideas, fix bugs. We hope that we didn’t let you down on this point.

And it’s not over! :)

There is already a new update in the pipeline for next week (with [b]keyboard remapping[/b]), and some exciting new additions for the official release (surprise!).

We will continue to support the game, fix bugs and add new contents in the coming months. However, we’d rather be honest with you: we need your help. We need you to spread the word, talk about the game and [b]share the love[/b]. 
You like Steredenn? The best way to help us is to speak about it! Contact your favorite youtuber, tweet about it and show the game to your friends.

We want to thank our awesome community for all the feedbacks and messages. As we often said on the forums, we cannot answer to each post but be sure we have (and will) read everything and we did our best to include your ideas.

Finally, a big thank to Simon Coroller, Etienne Marque and Zander Noriega for their awesome work on the game.

Be ready for the bullet storm.

-- Matthieu & Damien,
Pixelnest Studio.

notes.title: Steredenn 0.24.0: Super Sonic Shockwave
notes.notes:
Hi,

We have a small update this week for the few things we couldn't include in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/347160/announcements/detail/47640728067972165]0.23.0[/url].

We have fixed many bugs, improved the music, added some waves and a brand new upgrade. We also added some side-effects to a few upgrades to make them mix well all together. And as always, we made some tweaks to the balance.

[*] New upgrade: the [b]Minishield[/b]. An additional shield that can absorb one hit (collision or bullet). It regenerates itself when you are not firing. Be careful: the hitbox of the minishield is way bigger than the one of the ship. ;)
[*] Waves: 5 new.
[*] Improve the music and transitions.
[*] The tutorial is really skippable (you could skip it in the 0.23.0, but the game would launch it again at the beginning of the game if you didn't watch it completely).

[/list]

[*] Reduce the maximum duration of a wave to 1:30.

notes.title: Steredenn 0.23.0: The Bug Hunt
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's been some time since the last update. With the holidays and clients work, we had a bit less time for Steredenn. But fear not, this update is, as always, [b]huge[/b]. :)

[img]http://pixelnest.io/work/steredenn/medias/hangar.png[/img]

There's a few big things:
[list]
[*] [b]TONS[/b] of bug fixes and polish. This is the main aspect of this update. We have also reworked and added some upgrades. And, hopefully, we have balanced the weapons. [i]Thanks to you![/i]
[*] A [b]tutorial[/b]. Okay, we know that you guys have already digged in the game a lot, so this might not serve you. But with this, you will be able to show Steredenn to your friends and let them experience the game in a brand new way.
[*] A new boss. The [b]Destroyer MK-II[/b]. Harder than the first. ;)
[/list]
Okay, right, let's read the changelog.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] New mode: [b]tutorial[/b]! The first time you open the game, it will launch automatically. Then, it will be available in the normal mode by pressing "X" (pad) or "C" (keyboard).
[*] New boss: the [b]Destroyer MK-II[/b].
[*] New system: if an enemy is approaching you from the back, the game will tell you with a gentle warning.
[*] New upgrade: [b]Better shield[/b].
[*] New upgrade: [b]Semi-automatic weapons are fully automatic[/b].
[*] New upgrade: [b]One more chance to achieve a wave[/b]. It allows you to let one enemy goes away or to be hit once before loosing the wave objective.
[*] Upgrade redesign: [b]Improve collisions damages[/b] has been changed to [b]Unleashed a shockwave on collisions[/b]. Way more fun.
[*] Upgrade redesign: [b]Lasers invulnerability[/b] has been changed to [b]Absorb lasers temporarily[/b].
[*] Upgrade redesign: [b]Collisions invulnerability[/b] has been changed to [b]Collisions deal less damages[/b].
[*] Suicide bullets: new color code and better mechanic.
[*] Waves: 30 new.
[*] Revamped the shield mechanic of the bosses in the loops.
[*] Revamped — once again — the music system. Smoother and prettier.
[*] We have also added new sounds.
[*] Tweak the gamepad and keyboard. They should be more precise in low-speed areas.
[*] Nice fade-out between screens and reorganized main menu.
[*] And [i]tons of additional polish[/i].
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes/technical stuffs[/h1]

notes.title: Steredenn 0.22.0: Bullets Awakening
notes.notes:
Hey,

What was supposed to be a simple and quick update is in fact a major one for the game. This new version enhances Steredenn [b]so much[/b] — and adds a lot of new content as usual. We hope you will like it.

[img]http://pixelnest.io/work/steredenn/medias/loop.png[/img]

The main features are:
[list]
[*] Balancing!

  We entirely reworked the damage system. Before this update, when a bullet hit an enemy, it triggered a small invincibility timer. If another bullet hit the same enemy at the same time, it was ignored. No more. Combine your weapons and smash your opponents like never before. ;)

  We have added a whole new depth to our damage system too. Some weapons are now better against small ships, others are effective against bigger enemies, etc. You can still destroy everything with any weapon but some combinations are going to lead to faster destructions.

  Those two points mean we had to completely re-balance the game and the weapons. You will be surprised! It should be smoother and more pleasant. Tell us what you think. :]

[*] A new mode, the [b]Daily Run[/b]! Everyday, try to be the best in a dedicated leaderboard. You got [b]only one chance[/b]. Some days your weapons will be set by the game and there's even a slight chance that a run will have [i]no cargo at all[/i].
[*] Loops are now harder and better: it's not as simple as a restart anymore. Fear the suicide bullets.
[*] [b]Linux build![/b] We can assert that the game is running on a Kubuntu 64 bits but we need your feedback to make sure the game is running [b]on your system[/b]. Please report any issue on the forum: http://steamcommunity.com/app/347160/discussions/0/620713633861901691/.
[*] Two new defensive weapons, as suggested on the forums: the [b]Shieldbots[/b] and the [b]Reflector[/b].
[*] Two new bosses: the [b]Bomber MK-4[/b] and the [b]Frigate MK-3[/b].
[/list]

Finally, thanks to some members of the community and Gamepedia, Steredenn has now a Wiki! This will be the perfect place to get information about a weapon, an upgrade, or just discover about anything in the game. This is a community-made wiki: we will provide answers and information, but it's up to you to contribute and improve the content. ;)

Visit the Wiki on http://steredenn.gamepedia.com/Steredenn_Wiki.

Want more? See the complete changelog below. :)

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] New platform: [b]Linux[/b]!
[*] New mode: the [b]Daily Run[/b].
[*] New boss: the [b]Bomber MK-4[/b].
[*] New boss: the [b]Frigate MK-3[/b].
[*] New weapon: the [b]Shieldbots[/b].
[*] New weapon: the [b]Reflector[/b]. Reflect all the things!
[*] New enemy: the [b]Spiraler[/b].
[*] New enemy: the [b]Heavy Shielder[/b].
[*] New event in the loops: the [b]Nemesis[/b].
[*] Upgrade redesign: the energy and heavy upgrades have been improved. And we won't spoil the surprise.
[*] Loops have a lot of new mechanics to make them harder, better and more interesting.
[*] New patterns for the Mothership.
[*] New animation when you pick an upgrade.
[*] New environment for the first level during the loops.
[*] New junks after a boss destruction.
[*] New cosmetic events. The [b]Alliance[/b] and the [b]Research Stations[/b].
[*] The Game Over screen display the number of loops and your combo.
[*] New tint mechanism when you hit an enemy. Orange is less efficient, red is normal and pink is extremely efficient.
[*] Tweak the "Scores" UI a bit.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes/technical stuffs[/h1]
[list]
[*] No more nasty freezes between waves. If you are still encountering this problem (but you shouldn't), tell us on the forums.
[*] More efficient Flamebots.
[*] Fix a bug with the shields.
[*] Fix a bug of the Baygun and the Charger.
[*] Chainsaw enemies no longer stack.
[*] The Mothership should gives its score correctly.
[/list]
[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] All the weapons and enemies have been rebalanced. Slightly for the enemies… a lot for the weapons. Each weapon has a type (light, medium, heavy, fusion) and each enemy has an armor (small, medium, big, boss, building, blocker). If you combine the correct weapon against an enemy, you can unleash a devastating attack… Observe the game and try to learn how to maximize your damages. :)
[*] Upgraded some enemies' pattern for the loops. We still have some work to do on the bosses.
[*] Enemies and bosses are faster, more resistant and give more points during the loops.
[*] An event is only active during its effect, not for the whole level.
[*] Reworded some upgrades.
[*] The "+1 Health Point" is now "+2 Health Points".
[*] The "Drop Superior Weapons" upgrade has been removed.
[*] The "Category - +50% Drop Rate and +10% damages" is now "Category - +50% Drop Rate and +15% damages".
[*] The "Category - +50% Drop Rate and +15% damages" reset all the drop of its type. If you have picked an Hyperblaster before and you pick this upgrade for the "Bullets" category, you will have one more chance to drop it again.
[*] Specific upgrades have more chance to drop when you hold a weapon of their type.
[*] The Heavy Battleship shouldn't be invincible in the loops anymore. ;p
[*] Bots search for new enemies a bit faster.
[*] Bots target the bombtrap.
[*] Bonus have an increased time to live.
[/list]

Enjoy!

Out.

— Steredenn’s team.

notes.title: Steredenn 0.21.0: fear of a Mothership
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

New update today! There are three main things in this update:
[list]
[*] The [b]Mothership[/b] — the final big (dare I say huge?) boss. It's not fully done — the pacing is a bit too slow and we need to add a few patterns along with sounds — but it's a good start. 

By adding the Mothership, we have completed the first loop of the game. We will focus on the loops for the next updates. Of course, as soon as you beat the Mothership, it will be available in the Arena. It won't be easy, though. 

We have added the last music of Zander Noriega for when your are facing this deadly beast. Good luck captain.

[*] A [b]new mode[/b], unlocked by defeating the Mothership. This mode is the [b]"Superplay"[/b], which allows you to select a variant of the game (with a number). Each time you play this variant, you get the same waves, weapons and upgrades. It's perfect for speedruns or high-level trainings.

[*] [b]Tons of new contents[/b]: two new contact weapons, three new enemies, 43 waves and a whole new level (paving the way to the mothership).
[/list]
[img=http://pixelnest.io/work/steredenn/gifs/gif09.gif]

Of course, we have fixed and destroyed many bugs. 

[i]And we are very happy to say that we have annihilated one of the biggest bug in our bullet patterns: sometimes, the first bullet of a pattern was not following its direction.[/i] This is now over. Enjoy!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] New boss: the almighty [b]Mothership[/b]. With this boss, the standard run of the game is complete. We will continue to improve the Mothership in the following weeks.
[*] New mode: [b]Superplay[/b]. The Superplay mode removes lots of random in the game. You choose a variant — a number — of the game, and this variant will always generate the same waves, weapons and upgrades. This mode is unlocked when you finish (by beating the Mothership) the game once.
[*] New weapon: the [b]Sword[/b]. Crush those ships!
[*] New weapon: the [b]Jaw[/b]. Because… why not?
[*] New enemy: the [b]Heavy Turret[/b].
[*] New enemy: the [b]Heavy Fighter[/b].
[*] New enemy: the [b]Heavy Battleship[/b]. Bigger, deadlier, heavily armored. Don't mess with it.
[*] 43 new waves.
[*] Redesign: the [b]Flamethrower[/b], a shiny new burning beauty.©
[*] The player's ship shows a small aura when it is hit.
[*] You are invincible after beating a boss.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes/technical stuffs[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Ultralaser now uses the "destroy junks and rocks instantly" upgrade correctly.
[*] We have fixed some upgrades which were not properly applied to weapons.
[*] The "Backfire damages" upgrade is optimized.
[*] The Autocannon upgrade has been improved. It should no longer target invisible enemies.
[*] Weapons are sorted by category in the Arena.
[*] Bots and Autocannon can target a Cargo and should be more intelligent.
[*] The Battleship boss should now longer be blocked on its first pattern.
[*] We have re-done the level generator. It should remove the little freezes between waves, and it should also fix the infinite wave bug (we hope).
[*] We have also added a timer to trigger a new wave if a wave is frozen indefinitely.
[*] Rejoice: we have finally squashed a big bug in our patterns. For example, the Corvet first big pink bullet will go where it is expected.
[/list]
[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] The "Laser immunity" upgrade has been tweaked. Instead of protecting you completely, it slows you down when you are hit by a laser. It's still better than being hurt, but it's not without consequence anymore.
[*] The Cruiser boss is easier. You don't have to shoot a specific part to hurt him from now on.
[*] The Battleship boss' first pattern is a bit easier.
[*] The +25% score bonus upgrade has been reduced to +20%.
[*] The "CATEGORY +50% drop rate" upgrade also increases the damage of its category (+10%).
[*] Flamethrower: slighty better.
[*] The "Laser Rain" is a bit easier now. Hopefully.
[*] Bots benefit from the +XX% damages upgrades.
[*] The Rockets are a bit better.
[*] The Carrier boss is now launching fighters when she installs the shield.
[*] The Carrier boss has a bit less HPs.
[*] The Carrier boss fighters generation is a bit slower.
[*] The Hypergun does more damages.
[*] Thanks to the bug we eradicated in the patterns, some enemies are a bit stronger, like the fighters. Care must be taken!
[*] You will start to encounter some standard enemies with a shield. It's a new feature that we included partially for the moment. We will work on that in the future.
[/list]

As always, thanks for your support and do not hesitate to send feedbacks on the forums. ;)

Have fun.

Out.

— Steredenn’s team.

notes.title: Steredenn 0.20.0: UPGRADE ALL THE THINGS
notes.notes:
Fellow Steredenn players,

Today is a good (fantastic?) day! This update is [b]packed with so much stuffs[/b].

Before diving into the full changelog, let's talk a bit about the main additions.

[img=http://pixelnest.io/work/steredenn/gifs/upgrade.gif]

We have added a brand new [b]upgrade system[/b] for the player. They are randomly dropped by bosses and you can pick only one of those after the fight. Each upgrade will have a unique effect that will help you: additional damages, health points, score bonus... and many suprises! Choice will be hard and will have an impact on your run. [b]Pick wisely[/b].

You will also find two new weapons suggested by the community:
[list]
[*] The [b]Impaler[/b], a piercing gun that will ruin closed-by groups. Simple, effective, deadly.

notes.title: Steredenn 0.19.0
notes.notes:
Yeah! Finally! A new update.

Sorry guys: between a show (the Stunfest), the start of the Early Access, some external works and a few big issues, we took more time than expected to wrap this update. We will try our best to be more active in the coming weeks.

One thing that took many time was a problem with high-frequency (144hz) displays. We had a working solution, but it broke many patterns, so we rolled back. Hopefully, we have a workaround for the moment.

This update focuses on 3 aspects:
[list]
[*] The scoring system
[*] The weapons drop system
[*] The game UI
[/list]
We've made some big changes to improve those 3 areas. The scoring is smoother and more fun. It's also a lot less punishing. Let us know what you think! As for the weapons, we we were not satisfied by the current random distribution mechanic. So, we added a new level property on each weapon to distribute them in the game.

We fixed a ton of bugs too. Squashed, destroyed!

As always, give us your feedbacks on the Steam forums, please. ;)

Enough chitchat, let's see what's in this new release:

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New weapons drop system[/b]: we have changed the way the weapons are dropped. Before this update, each weapon had the same chance to be dropped. Now, we are using a level for each weapon to determine when it should be in a cargo. There's still a chance to get a high-end weapon at the beginning, though. This new system is subtle, but should make the game more enjoyable. ;)
[*] [b]New scoring system[/b]: we still need to tweak it a bit, but here what it does: when you finish a wave, you get one or two multipliers if you achieve some conditions, depending on the wave's type. Each enemy gives you some points multiplied by the combo. Each event increases the amount of points you get for an enemy.
[*] [b]New Score UI[/b]: handle the Steam leaderboards and have a "Focus on me" button. Be careful: we can (and we will) reset the leaderboards if we tweak the scoring system again. You have been warned, space wanderer! :)
[*] [b]New Game UI[/b]: more legible, more information, more beauty. Still some work to do.
[*] New weapon: the [b]Hypergun[/b]. It's a big powerful gatling.
[*] New weapon: [b]Minebots[/b]. Probably unbalanced, but super fun.
[*] New pirate: the [b]Chainsaw[/b]. It's a stupid ship that rush on you until it kills you.
[*] 16 new waves!
[*] New cosmetic event: [b]solar winds[/b].
[*] More junks after a boss.
[*] More catchphrases before a boss and during the introduction.
[*] The saw have a new animation when it's expanded/shrinked.
[*] Particles on the Death Ray laser.
[*] New charging effect for the shockwave.
[*] New mega-explosion for big bosses.
[*] Add tips when you die.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes/technical[/h1]
[list]
[*] The screen resolution is automagically chosen when the game starts.
[*] The music is correctly stopped when you disable it in the settings and you go in the pause during the game.
[*] The Destroyer boss should always explode, now.
[*] EMP mine AND slowing weapons won't block the player.
[*] The flamethrower throws more… flames. And destroy missiles all the time. Yeah.
[*] Comets' trail are destroyed properly.
[*] Bots, hopefully, explode correctly. Fiou.
[*] Handle more game controllers. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347160/discussions/0/620713633858041024/]See the FAQ for the list[/url].
[*] Minefield are not stretched after the hyperspace.
[*] Bonus' holo are hidden after the boss cinematic.
[*] Remove the baygun double shot trick.
[*] Fixed those damn missiles that wouldn't die.
[*] Remove the Mothership-replace-the-Battleship bug. Sorry for the spoiler. :/
[/list]
[h1]Balance[/h1]

[b]Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] Renaming:
[list]
[*] Supergun -> Blaster
[*] Hypergun -> Hyperblaster
[*] Megagun -> Supergun
[*] Megagun 2 -> Megagun (oops)
[*] Flamesbots -> Flamebots
[*] Rocketsbots -> Rocketbots
[*] Sentrybots -> Gunbots
[/list]
[*] Rockets have been redesigned: they have a slight auto-aim, a bigger area of effect and are shot one by one. It's better, trust me.
[*] Gunbots: bigger bullet.
[*] Flamebots: more ammo.
[*] Stasisbots: more ammo, increased range, less damages.
[*] Death Ray: MORE damages, increased cooldown. It should destroy almost anything instantly.
[*] Saw: more damages.
[*] Driller: less damages.
[*] BayGun: woooow. It's the most destructive weapon in the game now, as it should always have been. Increased area of effect, too. Still hard to hit, but when it hits... you'll see. ;)
[*] Shield: its energy depletes faster when hit by big bullets and big lasers.
[/list]
[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] Turrets have a bigger hitbox.
[*] Shielders' shield can be broken by more weapons.
[*] The Destroyer boss ultra-monstrous-laser does one more damage to your ship. 4 damages?! Are you mad!!?
[/list]
[b]Player[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes, we are. That's why we have added 0.5s to the player's grace time after a hit. ;)
[/list]

Enjoy!

Out.

— Steredenn’s team.
